title: Camp Nichole
description:
It’s the middle of the night. You’re alone… in your bunk… and I climb into your bed… settle myself on top of you, my thighs hot around your torso.

You can’t help but just melt underneath me, and give in to what I desire. And you might just find yourself wanting things you never even dreamed of before.

This file is dripping with ASMR, immersion, intimacy, and control. Oh, and yes- ice cream licking. 🍦👅
